I also did not find a strong direct 2024 source on internet shutdowns specifically within the search budget; the evidence I found is strongest on surveillance and administrative coercion rather than shutdowns.","evidence":[{"title":"Iran: authorities unleash heavily militarized clampdown to hide protest massacres","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-03-06","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/iran-draconian-campaign-to-enforce-compulsory-veiling-laws-through-surveillance-and-mass-car-confiscations/","summary":"Amnesty documented widespread surveillance, mass police checks, confiscations, prosecutions, flogging, prison terms, and “morality” classes. This is direct evidence of administrative harassment and coercive monitoring used to suppress political and social freedom.","question_ids":["4B.9","4B.3","4B.5","4B.7"]},{"title":"Iran: two years after Woman Life Freedom uprising, impunity for crimes reigns supreme","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-09-11","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/iran-two-years-after-woman-life-freedom-uprising-impunity-for-crimes-reigns-supreme/","summary":"Amnesty said authorities still had not carried out impartial investigations and instead used harassment and arbitrary detention against victims’ families. That supports a continuing pattern of intimidation and control, not political freedom.","question_ids":["4B.9","4B.3","4B.5","4B.7"]},{"title":"Iran: New compulsory veiling law intensifies oppression of women and girls","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-12-10","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/iran-new-compulsory-veiling-law-intensifies-oppression-of-women-and-girls/","summary":"Amnesty reported that the new law expands enforcement powers for police, intelligence, IRGC, and Basij, and codifies harsh punishment for veiling-related noncompliance. That is direct evidence that the state used harassment and surveillance-like repression against political freedom.","question_ids":["4B.9","4B.3","4B.5","4B.6","4B.7"]},{"title":"Iran pauses implementation of stricter hijab law for women","publisher":"Euronews / AP","date":"2024-12-18","url":"https://www.euronews.com/2024/12/18/iran-pauses-implementation-of-stricter-hijab-law-for-women","summary":"Senior bodies temporarily paused implementation of the stricter hijab law.
